question:
**Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

A person who believes that the world is controlled by the power of the stars**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Astrologer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Astrologer"** refers to a person who studies astrology, which is the belief that the positions and movements of celestial bodies (stars and planets) influence human affairs and natural events. (ज्योतिषी)
 
 
• **Example:** The astrologer predicted that she would have a successful year based on her birth chart.
 
 
 
• **"Astrologer"** is different from other professions related to celestial bodies, like astronomers or meteorologists, as it focuses on the mystical or spiritual interpretation of celestial movements. (ज्योतिषी)
 
 
• **Example:** He consulted an astrologer to choose an auspicious day for his wedding.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Astrologer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Astronomer **(खगोलशास्त्री): A scientist who studies celestial bodies such as stars, planets, and galaxies.
 
 
• **Example:** The astronomer used a telescope to observe the distant stars.
 
 

 
• **Clairvoyant **(अतीन्द्रिय ज्ञानी): A person who claims to have supernatural ability to perceive events in the future or beyond normal sensory contact.
 
 
• **Example:** The clairvoyant claimed to know what would happen next in her life.
 
 

 
• **Meteorologist** (मौसम वैज्ञानिक): A scientist who studies weather and atmospheric conditions.
 
 
• **Example:** The meteorologist predicted heavy rainfall for the coming week.

The correct answer is **Option 2**.&
